5.9.3 NVM Service Call-backs
If a system has NvM users outside of the RTE (e.g.
other BSW modules or non-
AUTOSAR legacy code) the NvM ECUC configuration may provide the names of extra
header files which must be included by the NvM module to access all available call-
backs via the NvMBlockHeaderInclude configuration parameter.
[SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09125]
Users of NvM callback APIs provided by the
RTE ⌈If the existence criteria for the RTE NvM callbacks are met for an
NV Block, the associated NvMBlockHeaderInclude parameter must be set to
Rte_<NvBlockSwComponentType>.h.⌋
Note: The existence criteria for the RTE NvM callbacks are specified in the subsections
of this chapter.
